comment: Digest lookup for a high-entropy generated API bearer token: 40 URL-safe chars from secrets.token_urlsafe(32), about 240 bits. Human passwords instead use bcrypt cost 12. No human-password verifier uses this hash.

Logged user.id is a database UUID. FeedbackCreate.category is Literal[bug, feature_request, data_issue, other]. Free-text message, contact and user-agent are not logged at this sink; newlines cannot pass category validation.

Intentional user-selected JSON upload after Inspect frozen distribution. The traced source is a component-test readFileSync fixture. Destination is the configured API plus constant endpoint; file data is only body. credentials/include, no-store and redirect/error are enforced.

Owned disposable services only: fresh 192-bit credentials, exclusive 0600 files under a 0700 TemporaryDirectory, inherited DSNs/cloud/mail secrets excluded. Services and directory removed on cleanup. Required temporary local config, never production credentials.

SHA-256 binds an exact disposable-service DSN to a private one-hour capability; this is integrity comparison, not password authentication. DSN password has 192 random bits. Independent process/container ownership checks also apply.

Mode fault injection deliberately changes a synthetic output to 0644. The enclosing test requires the final output verifier to raise ValueError. This verifies rejection of permissive files; it is not production output creation.
